text:
ashley: Quick heads-up — SparkBridge (new marketplace partner) asked for a Marketplace-ready quickstart: Terraform module + concise reference architecture doc + CI smoke tests. They want a partner preview next Tue. Who can take module + examples?
kevin: +1. I can help with CI and ARM/Graviton compatibility tests. We should avoid reinventing the refkit layout.
marta: I can own the Terraform module and examples. prefer to publish a single module with optional providers for aws/gcp/azure. want standard outputs (endpoint, lb_dns) and well-documented variables.
jonah: I'll own the marketplace metadata + short launch checklist and partner-facing README. can also add reference arch diagrams (svg + PNG).
samir: FYI we need to check licensing for partner assets and any sample data. tagging sec-team — @sec-bot can you flag major compliance issues?
sec-bot: Thanks @samir — quick check: ensure no hardcoded credentials, add sample-data disclaimer, KMS/HSM integration doc if customer-managed keys will be used. Also add CLA note for partner-contributed modules.
kevin: for CI, suggest a matrix: terraform validate + fmt + terraform init/apply (small infra) on x86 and arm runners. Also smoke test generation latency with a tiny model container.
ashley: can we reuse the refkit module pattern? (inputs/outputs, examples/*, tests/*)
marta: yes — plan: folder layout: examples/basic, examples/marketplace, tests/smoke. I'll add a terraform example that spins up a single node pool and deploys the quickstart app container.
kevin: sample terraform snippet for module consumers:
```hcl
module "sparkbridge_refkit" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/ref-terraform.git//sparkbridge?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}
```
jonah: marketplace metadata checklist (quick): listing.yml, quickstart.md (200–300 words), architecture.svg, terraform module link, supported regions, tested instance families. I'll draft today.
samir: also confirm partner wants a private VPC option in the refarch (yes/no). if yes, include subnet var examples and sample route table.
ashley: they said private VPC is required for customers in regulated industries — include it.
marta: action items: 1) I build module + examples (owner: marta). 2) kevin sets up CI matrix + arm runners (owner: kevin). 3) jonah drafts marketplace metadata and refarch doc (owner: jonah). 4) ashley does partner sync + acceptance criteria (owner: ashley).
terraform-bot: lint check queued for branch feature/sparkbridge-quickstart — 3/3 checks passed.
kevin: timeline: module + smoke tests by Fri EOD, marketplace draft by Mon, partner preview Tue. good?
ashley: sounds good. I'll schedule a 30m sync with SparkBridge for Tue afternoon and share the acceptance criteria. thanks everyone :tada:
marta: ping if you need sample credentials rotation snippet — I'll add an example for KMS.
jonah: i'll include the marketplace checklist and a one-page partner runbook.
ashley: closing: owners confirmed and timeline set. I'll post follow-ups with PR links in this thread.
__notes: thread follows agents.md rules: messages are a single continuous string, prefixed by sender names. no title field included.
